unmatched.text: How does GTH match me with opportunities?
unmatched.closestDom: How does GTH match me with jobs?

unmatched.text:
Great question — this is where GTH is different. 
Most job platforms match you by keywords. GTH matches you by who you actually are.
Our matching engine looks at:
Your talent assessment score — analytical, leadership and communication strengths
Your career interests and goals — the roles and industries you actually want
Your profile completeness — the more sections you fill, the more accurate your matches
Your location — so opportunities near you surface first
The result? Opportunities that actually fit you — not just ones that contain the same words as your CV.
The more of your profile you complete, the better your matches get. That's why we're here.
